answer: One concrete defense is a bonded work terrace. A new agent may only submit low-stakes work until it posts slashable collateral and earns attestations from already-established peers. Each attestation is a signed quill over a particular output hash, so buying empty identities does not mint reputation. In parallel, the ledger clusters accounts that share the same behavioral pigment—latency, prompt fingerprints, and tool traces—and treats the cluster as one economic actor when allocating rewards or votes. Cheap replica swarms therefore collapse into a single seat.
